source: A FNAF movie 2 rp thats realistic and has the full FNAF movie 2 map with all the characters on a menu and some gamepasses

image_prompt.text: The main dining room of the pizzeria as the oversized gathering core, sized for a full server of roleplayers
Set-piece roleplay spots - the show stage, the party tables, the security desk and its camera monitors
The animatronic show stage, visible across the main room so players orient by it
The pizzeria as an enterable interior - office, hallways, vents, kitchen and back rooms
A faithful realistic recreation of the full FNAF Movie 2 map rather than an original horror restaurant

notes: P3: the play space is the building interior, so interiors generate separately.
The character menu and the gamepasses are screen-space and monetisation features with no layout footprint; recorded but not placed.
Preset caveat: Morph Roleplay assumes a static town with an outdoor square; here the settlement is a single interior venue.

open_questions.ask: Should the map be the pizzeria interior only, or include the exterior lot and street around it?
Is the character menu a GUI morph picker, or an in-world room where the animatronics stand on display?

coverage_missing.ask: Interior only, or interior plus the exterior lot?
The movie building alone, or the surrounding block too?
GUI morph picker, or an in-world display room?

answers.ask: Should the map be the pizzeria interior only, or include the exterior lot and street around it?
answers.answer: Include the full pizzeria interior plus a small exterior lot and street around it for a complete realistic movie map.

answers.ask: Is the character menu a GUI morph picker, or an in-world room where the animatronics stand on display?
answers.answer: Use a GUI morph picker menu with all characters available to select.
